offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures center pivot and lateral move irrigation systems for farmers, and highway safety barriers and crash cushions for government road agencies. Irrigation is sold through independent dealers, and infrastructure products go directly to agencies and contractors.

primary_products.value: center pivot irrigation systems; lateral move irrigation systems; irrigation parts; highway guardrail and barrier systems; crash cushions

primary_services.value: irrigation installation and maintenance; highway safety system installation; precision irrigation software services

customer_segment.value: B2B: farmers and agricultural operations, plus road construction contractors; B2G: state and federal transportation agencies buying highway safety products

revenue_model.value: product sales: irrigation systems, irrigation parts and highway safety barriers; subscription: digital subscriptions for precision irrigation monitoring software; service fees: installation and maintenance of irrigation and road safety systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds irrigation and road safety products, sold to farmers, dealers and agencies; software / platform: precision irrigation software used by growers to manage pivot systems

geography_served.value: global: irrigation sold in many countries worldwide, road safety products sold mainly in the United States

specialization.value: diversified: irrigation equipment for farmers and infrastructure safety products for transportation agencies

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent irrigation dealers selling center pivot systems to farmers; direct sales: road safety products sold directly to state and federal agencies and contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: highway safety products must meet federal crash-testing and roadside safety standards set by FHWA and state agencies
